name: csas-engine
description: CSAS Engine – Context-Adaptive Semantic Application Screening

scripts.dev: mkdir -p frontend/dist && concurrently -n wrangler,vite -c blue,green "npx wrangler pages dev frontend/dist --port 8788" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev frontend/dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist
scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
